label: FP
reason: The ternary operator assigns 'bar' to 'param' only when (7*42)-num <= 200. Since num=106 makes (294-106)=188 <= 200, 'bar' is always 'param'. However, 'param' is never used in the cookie value or name construction; the cookie value is derived from SecureRandom and the name is fixed via className parsing. Thus, no user-controlled data reaches the sink.

evidence.note: param flows to bar but not used in cookie value/name; SecureRandom generates cookie value
